method: AI-assisted editorial definitions, written in Azerbaijani and English. No claimed professional linguistic review.
selection: 350 established scientific and medical headwords, all absent from the prior dictionary under NFC/case-insensitive matching. 349 are single words; one is an established multiword term; no conjugations or generated plural/case forms. Links are broad topic associations, not synonym or etymology assertions.
verification: Definitions reviewed for internal factual consistency. Limited external checks confirm selected technical spellings and usage; the references are not a claim that every entry was sourced or professionally verified.
